链流甲：把 a.txt 写出来
链流乙：把 b.txt 写出来
链流丙：把 c.txt 写出来并说一共几步

eval: (async()=>{const t0=Date.now();for(;;){const d=await fetch('/api/sessions').then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>[]);const hit=(d||[]).filter(s=>(s.title||'').indexOf('链流三步')>=0);if(hit.length){const el=document.querySelector('#sessions .it[data-id="'+hit[0].id+'"]');if(el)el.click();return JSON.stringify({found:true,sid:hit[0].id.slice(0,8)});}if(Date.now()-t0>30000)return JSON.stringify({found:false,n:(d||[]).length});await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,700))}})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now();for(;;){const t=document.querySelector('#stream').innerText||'';const all=t.indexOf('链流甲')>=0&&t.indexOf('链流乙')>=0&&t.indexOf('链流丙')>=0;if(all)return JSON.stringify({all3:true,ms:Date.now()-t0});if(Date.now()-t0>60000)return JSON.stringify({all3:false,tail:t.slice(-160)});await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,1000))}})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now();for(;;){const d=await fetch('/api/digest').then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({items:[]}));const hit=(d.items||[]).filter(e=>(e.title||'').indexOf('链流三步')>=0);if(hit.length)return JSON.stringify({inDigest:true,last:hit[0].text.slice(0,40),onePerChain:hit.length===1});if(Date.now()-t0>40000)return JSON.stringify({inDigest:false,n:(d.items||[]).length});await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,1500))}})()
